decision: Use a bounded comparative design with predeclared outcomes and uncertainty rather than a post-task satisfaction survey alone.
credible_alternatives: Collect only self-reported usefulness; rejected because it cannot answer the performance question.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Predeclared checklist and standard-instruction conditions, with baseline adjustment, missingness record and uncertainty intervals.
assumptions_and_risks: Synthetic data, limited sample, task specificity, non-blinded condition and sensitivity to missingness assumptions.
conditional_commitment: Use a bounded comparative design with predeclared outcomes and uncertainty rather than a post-task satisfaction survey alone.
early_test: Pilot the task timing, scoring rubric, missingness capture and data export on synthetic records before recruitment.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
